facts.fact: La Sentinelle reports that in December 2023 a digitisation team set up the electronic patient record (DEM), replacing the paper file, at the public proximity health establishment of Bouchegouf commune, in Guelma wilaya.
La Sentinelle says medical and paramedical teams in Guelma and Bouchegouf communes can now directly access patients' electronic records, with the file extended to the laboratory and dental care room.

systems.owner: Direction de la Santé et de la Population de Guelma

DZA.note: Health service digitisation only; no local government office connection stated.
